entries.text: Highlights Added Client credentials can be loaded from AWS Secrets Manager. RunWorker now loads client options with the go.temporal.io/sdk/contrib/aws/secretsmanager envconfig extension, so the API key and TLS cert/key/CA can be configured as secret IDs via TEMPORAL_EXT_AWS_SECRETS_MANAGER_* env vars or profile.<profile>.ext.aws_secrets_manager in the config file. Breaking Changes Raised the minimum supported Go version from 1.25.4 to 1.26.0.

entries.text: Highlights Added Added client.Options.RPCTimeout to configure the default RPC timeout cap, including raising it above 10 seconds. Shorter caller deadlines still take precedence, and calls with dedicated timeouts (such as long polls) are unchanged. converter.WorkflowTaskFailureError: an opt-in error a PayloadCodec can return from Encode or Decode on a workflow-side payload path to fail the current Workflow Task rather than the Workflow Execution, so the server retries the task and a transient codec failure can recover while the execution stays open. See the WorkflowTaskFailureError docs for the honored paths, exclusions, and retry guidance. Added experimental SignalWithStartWorkflow API to the workflow package. Added opt-in EncodeHeaders tracing options and workflow.CodecContextPropagator for header codec processing using the configured client's codec. Only opted-in producers' output is encoded; user-supplied wire-ready headers are unchanged. Receiving consumers use private decoded views. Custom converter wrappers can expose codec stages through converter.PayloadCodecProvider. Added experimental Event Groups support: workflow.NewEventGroup, workflow.WithEventGroups, and EventGroups on workflow command options. Update handlers get an implicit group. Signal handlers do not. Added client interceptor hooks for Client.GetWorkflow (GetWorkflowRun), WorkflowRun.Get/GetWithOptions (GetWorkflowResult), and Client.GetWorkflowHistory. Handle interception runs before lazy target resolutio

entries.text: Highlights Added AdditionalProfileFields allows for extra fields at any level of nesting within a profile, rather than just the top level Experimental client config extensions. Extensions implement ClientConfigExtension, read their own config from profile.<profile>.ext.<name> TOML tables (exposed as ClientConfigProfile.Ext) and env vars, and are passed via LoadClientOptionsRequest.Extensions to contribute client plugins to the loaded options. Strict mode does not reject keys under ext, and ext is preserved by ClientConfig.ToTOML. Breaking Changes Raised the minimum supported Go version from 1.25.4 to 1.26.0. Config files with duplicate array keys now return an error due to a bug fix in BurntSushi/toml v1.6.0.

entries.text: Highlights Added Added workflow.ChildWorkflowOptions.VersioningOverride for explicitly pinning, auto-upgrading, or one-time routing a child workflow independently of its parent. This requires Temporal Server 1.32.0 or later. Added experimental converter.NewTransferTypeConverter API that implements transfer type conversion. converter.GetDefaultDataConverter() now supports transfer type conversion. Added autoscaling support for server poller groups, with per-group coverage and sticky-backlog prioritization. SimpleMaximum is unchanged, and autoscaling behaves as before when no poller groups are configured. TestWorkflowEnvironment and TestActivityEnvironment now run worker plugins set through SetWorkerOptions(worker.Options{Plugins: ...}), which were previously ignored. Once plugins are set, SetWorkerOptions may not be called again on that environment, and what a plugin registers in StartWorker is undone at StopWorker. TestActivityEnvironment now has RegisterDynamicActivity and implements worker.ActivityRegistry again. temporalnexus.ConvertNexusLinkToLinkWorkflow, the decoding counterpart of ConvertWorkflowLinkToNexusLink. Added workflow.NewLocalVar[T](ctx) for type-safe values bound to a workflow run that can be accessed from workflow code and workflow interceptors. Copies of a workflow.LocalVar[T] share identity. entries.summary: Fixed workflowcheck sometimes missing non-deterministic code reached through; a same-package call cycle, such as inside encoding/json. A workflow calling; such code could pass on one run and fail on the next; it is now…
entries.text: Highlights Fixed Fixed workflowcheck sometimes missing non-deterministic code reached through a same-package call cycle, such as inside encoding/json. A workflow calling such code could pass on one run and fail on the next; it is now reported on every run. Projects with intermittent workflowcheck failures may see them become consistent. Reasons are now reported in a stable source order instead of varying between runs.
